transcript.text: Hello! This is the Legal Coordination Assistant at Smallest AI. I can help you with our NDAs, MSAs, or vendor registration. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I want to know your pricing per minute for voice AI.

I don't have access to specific pricing or commercial details here. For pricing on our voice AI, you'll need to reach out to our sales team. I can help you with legal agreements like NDAs or MSAs if you're ready for those. Would you like to proceed with a legal process?
Ok, then who handles NDA execution?

NDA execution is handled by our legal team. You can send your NDA or our standard template to legal@smallest.ai, and Manjari will review it within two business days. Would you like to send an NDA over?
